title: Gemini AI Gateway tool result conversion (GeminiAdapter.chat_to_model): tool message content that is not a JSON object is sent as functionResponse.response {"result": ...}
answers: Why does a multi-turn tool-calling chat through the gateway fail with a 500 when a tool returns plain text like 'Status: 200 OK' for Gemini or Vertex AI?
How does the gateway convert OpenAI tool message content (empty string, null, list of content parts, JSON number or list) into a Gemini functionResponse?
Where is the tool message content parsed into the Gemini function response for chat and streaming requests?
body:
Path: OpenAI-style chat requests with `role: "tool"` messages sent through the AI Gateway to Gemini, streaming chat, and Gemini models on Vertex AI (which calls the same method via super()). The chokepoint is mlflow/gateway/providers/gemini.py:GeminiAdapter.chat_to_model, which turns each tool message into a Gemini functionResponse part.
Rule: Build `response` with mlflow/gateway/providers/gemini.py:_tool_result_to_response, never with a bare `json.loads`. Content that parses to a JSON object is passed through unchanged; anything else (plain text, empty string, null, list of content parts, JSON number/string/list/null, or a parse TypeError) is wrapped as `{"result": <content>}`, because Gemini requires `response` to be an object.
Symptom: A tool result such as plain text ('Status: 200 OK') made the request fail with a JSON decode error and a 500 before reaching Gemini, breaking any multi-turn tool conversation once the first tool result was in history. Non-object JSON such as `42` was sent as-is and rejected because Gemini needs an object.
Constraints: Applies only to request-side tool message content. The helper does not change the functionCall name/id mapping or grouping of parallel tool results, which are handled in chat_to_model separately. Tested by tests/gateway/providers/test_gemini.py:test_gemini_chat_function_calling_tool_result_content, parametrized over text, empty string, JSON object, JSON number, JSON list and content parts.
applies: Gateway Gemini request conversion in mlflow/gateway/providers/gemini.py for tool message content, including Gemini on Vertex AI and streaming chat that share GeminiAdapter.chat_to_model.
says: Chat gateway crashes with a 500 error when a tool returns plain text.
Gateway calls fail when tools provide numbers or lists instead of JSON objects.
Multi-turn Gemini chat should support text outputs and empty results from external tools.
Conversations on Vertex AI break after a function returns non-object data.
search: AI Gateway request conversion wraps non-object tool message content in a result field dictionary for Gemini functionResponse parts. Implemented in mlflow/gateway/providers/gemini.py:_tool_result_to_response and called by GeminiAdapter.chat_to_model for Gemini, streaming chat, and Vertex AI models, avoiding 500 JSON decode errors. Content parsing to a JSON object passes through unchanged, whereas plain text, empty strings, nulls, lists of content parts, and JSON numbers or lists are wrapped as an object. Applies only to request-side tool content without altering functionCall mapping or parallel tool result grouping, tested in tests/gateway/providers/test_gemini.py:test_gemini_chat_function_calling_tool_result_content.
